title: Currywurst mit Sauerkraut und Senf
description: A popular German street food dish, Currywurst mit Sauerkraut und Senf combines the flavors of spicy curry ketchup with tangy sauerkraut and creamy mustard.
instructions: Grill the bratwurst over medium-high heat until browned on all sides and cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix together the curry ketchup and nutmeg (if using).
Brush the curry ketchup mixture onto the bratwurst slices.
Top each bratwurst slice with a spoonful of sauerkraut, a dollop of mustard, and a sprinkle of pickled mustard seeds (if using).
Garnish with sliced pickles and serve immediately.
